name: All Signs Customizer for WooCommerce
author: vertim

sections.description:
About the All Signs Customizer

  • Plugin site: signsdesigner.us

Overview

All Signs Customizer adds a configurable sign editor to WooCommerce products.
It supports products such as acrylic signs, metal signs, aluminum signs, door signs, and plastic signs.

Features

  • Custom TTF fonts support
  • Optional Google Fonts support for font families selected in the plugin
  • Custom colors palette for limited colors usage
  • Definition of customization sizes and number of characters per text
  • Translation ready
  • Shortcode available
  • Design data in cart
  • Pricing calculation
  • Automatic calculation of text height
  • Responsive and user-friendly

Pro features

  • More Size
  • More Colors
  • Advanced materials
  • More Configurations
  • Template designs
  • Image upload in configurator
  • SVG and PDF export
  • Additional material components
  • Additional configurator options

Live Demo

DEMO CUSTOM All Signs Customizer.

Developer Notes

Source code (unminified assets included):
https://github.com/vertim-coders/all-sign-customizer-for-woocommerce-free

Actions/Filters and template overrides are documented in the developer section of the docs.
sections.installation:
Minimum Requirements

  • WordPress 5.0 or greater
  • Woocommerce version 7.4 or greater
  • PHP version 7.0 or greater
  • MySQL version 5.0 or greater

This section describes how to install the plugin and get it working

Automatic installation (easiest way)

To do an automatic install of All Signs Customizer, log in to your WordPress dashboard, navigate to the Plugins menu and click Add New.

In the search field type “All Signs Customizer” and click Search Plugins. Once you have found it you can install it by simply clicking “Install Now”.

Manual installation

Uploading in WordPress Dashboard

  1. Download `all-signs-customizer-for-woocommerce.zip`
  2. Navigate to the ‘Add New’ in the plugins dashboard
  3. Navigate to the ‘Upload’ area
  4. Select `all-signs-customizer-for-woocommerce.zip` from your computer
  5. Click ‘Install Now’
  6. Activate the plugin in the Plugin dashboard

Using FTP

  1. Download `all-signs-customizer-for-woocommerce.zip`
  2. Extract the `all-signs-customizer-for-woocommerce` directory to your computer
  3. Upload the `all-signs-customizer-for-woocommerce` directory to the `/wp-content/plugins/` directory
  4. Activate the plugin in the Plugin dashboard

The WordPress codex contains instructions on how to install a WordPress plugin.

Updating

You can use automatic update to update the plugin safely.
sections.faq:
Where can I find All Signs Customizer documentation and user guides

You can also access our online documentation here

If you get stuck you can open a ticket here.

Will All Signs Customizer work with my theme?

All Signs Customizer works with any theme, including the default WordPress themes.

Does the plugin use any external services?

The plugin can optionally load Google Fonts font files for font families selected in the plugin settings. This happens only when a Google Font is selected in the plugin.

Service name: Google Fonts
Service URL: https://fonts.google.com/
Service domains: https://fonts.googleapis.com/ and https://fonts.gstatic.com/
Privacy policy: https://policies.google.com/privacy
Terms of service: https://policies.google.com/terms
Account required: No

Where can I review the source code for the generated JavaScript and CSS files?

The plugin ships with its uncompiled source code in the src/ directory.
Production assets are generated into assets/js/ and assets/css/ with webpack.
Bundled browser-side third-party utilities, including the local PDFObject helper used for PDF previews, are stored in assets/utilities/.

Build workflow:

  1. Run npm install
  2. Run npm run build

The repository also includes the build configuration in package.json and webpack.config.js, and bundled third-party browser libraries in assets/utilities/.
